topics.name: Canonical File Classification
topics.purpose: Define exact classification rules for root bootstrap, canonical definitions, history, generated projections, patch artifacts, evidence and unrelated repository files.

semantics.root_rule: Repository-root Contract Format artifact is classified separately from canonical/json definitions.
semantics.definition_rule: canonical/json active definition files must declare compatible canonical source roles.
semantics.history_rule: history/** never participates in active semantics by default.
semantics.projection_rule: Generated UML/tree/index/docs never become canonical definitions.
semantics.patch_rule: Patch packages/files are candidate change artifacts, not accepted sources.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unclassified artifacts block strict reconciliation if they may affect canonical semantics.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

hard_gates.condition: patch JSON loaded as active definition
